answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring economic capital rather than mere computational effort. An attacker attempting to flood an orchard of identities must secure significant collateral, making the cost of creating fake nodes akin to building a house from expensive timber. Without this capital, the network provides a velvet cushion of security that filters out low-value actors, ensuring that voting weight scales proportionally to the verifiable investment of the participant.
